unit.why: A short anecdote: the Kotzker rebbe, in a cheerful mood, is pressed by his attendant R. Zvi Hirsh about the 36 righteous and answers 'what does my Meir Yehiel lack'. It is followed by a brief attributed report about R. Reuven Horowitz.
unit.boundary_note: Division ends with the heading 'מענין לימוד', which belongs to the next section (on study). It also contains a bracketed genealogical note by the author.

stories.end_quote: והוא שלישי מל״ו צדיקים שהיו אז
stories.summary_en: The Kotzker rebbe, in a cheerful revealing mood, answered his attendant R. Zvi Hirsh Tomaszower's probing question about who the 36 hidden righteous are with 'what does my Meir Yehiel [of Gostynin] lack'. A further report, in the name of the Seer of Lublin, says that R. Reuven Horowitz, author of Dudaim ba-Sadeh, had the soul of Rav Hamnuna Saba and was one of the 36.

quotes: מי יודע בעתים הללו מי המה הל״ו צדיקים
והוא שלישי מל״ו צדיקים שהיו אז
